ANCHORS -- two reproductions disagree, and the paper broke the tie. CEST gives 完全没有 / 有一点 / 中等 / 相当多 / 非常多; xinlixue.cn gives 没有或非常轻微 / 有一点 / 中等程度 / 很强烈 / 非常强烈. The CEST set is what ships, because the paper glosses the endpoints as '1 (not at all) and 5 (extremely)' and 完全没有 is exactly 'not at all' whereas 没有或非常轻微 is 'none or very slight'. The CEST set is also the standard Chinese rendering of Watson's original anchors (相当多 = 'quite a bit'). The paper itself supplies only the two endpoints, so the middle three anchors have no study-side gloss at all.

MAPPING (paper_order, Step 5b PARTIAL). The IRW code IS the source column name -- data/qi_2025_self_reported_scales.R builds the item list as paste0('PA_', 1:9) and paste0('NA_', 1:9) and reads those columns straight off the workbook header, so this is core-model s3 pattern 1 with no positional step. But the source column name carries no text, so pattern 1's exemption buys nothing and none was claimed. Two separate inferences were made and they are verified to very different degrees. (a) BLOCK: that PA_* are the 9 positive adjectives and NA_* the 9 negative ones. Verified against a published number -- Qi et al. report Cronbach's alpha for THIS sample as .91 (PA) and .88 (NA), and the shipped block assignment gives .906 and .876, within .005 of both. Rivals: swapping a single item across blocks gives .839 / .800; treating all 18 as one unreversed scale gives .675; reverse-scoring any one item drops its block to .782 / .765. (b) WITHIN-BLOCK ORDER: that PA_1..PA_9 and NA_1..NA_9 follow the instrument's own presentation order (PA = positions 6,7,8,9,10,14,15,16,17 of the 18-item form; NA = positions 1,2,3,4,5,11,12,13,18). THIS IS NOT VERIFIED, and the negative result is printed by verify_qi_2025_panas.R rather than left silent. The strongest available route is a semantic-facet prediction inside the NA block -- fear {害怕, 紧张, 惊恐, 战战兢兢}, self-conscious {内疚, 羞愧}, anger {恼怒, 易怒}, sadness {难过} should show higher within-facet than between-facet correlations -- scored as mean(within r) - mean(between r) over all 9! = 362,880 relabellings. The shipped order scores -0.0012 and ranks 175,681st of 362,880 (top 48.4%), i.e. exactly chance. Two other routes were tried and also failed to discriminate: per-item correlations with a correctly keyed Rosenberg total (Esteem items 3,5,8,9,10 reversed; alpha .885 against the paper's published .89) run 0.21-0.57 across the PA items and -0.24 to -0.53 across NA with no pattern matching the predicted content (羞愧的/ashamed, predicted to be the most esteem-negative NA item, is the LEAST at -0.24), and the same for a SWLS total. The 18 adjectives are same-range, same-polarity single words within each block, so there is nothing for a statistic to grip -- this is the trap the instrument_rights_register already records for the Temporal Focus Scale. Hence PARTIAL: the polarity block and the non-reversal are pinned, no item is distinguished from the other eight in its own block.
